trust_decision.summary: Stored username, book slug and note slug are trusted as single path components when the migrate export commands join them under the export directory. The only input-side guard is huma `pattern` tags, which are unanchored and so ineffective.

landing_point.why: The summary names the book/note slug in migrate export. This is the first path.Join of user.Username/book.Slug in commandMigrateExportData.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: backend/cli/migrate.go:287-340 (commandMigrateExportDataV1, the `export-v1` legacy format). It is a second export implementation with its own path layout: note slug + ".md" file, plus a separate assets dir.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: export-v1 is the old format kept for compatibility. The HTTP schema fix looks like it already makes stored slugs safe, and OIDC/CLI-created usernames come from a trusted IdP or operator.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Export must still write every legitimate user/book/note, including slugs that `migrate import` stores verbatim from directory names (e.g. containing dots or uppercase, never pattern-checked). It must skip only the bad entry, not abort the whole export. Valid hyphen/digit slugs like `my-note-1` must stay accepted by the schema.

O6_input_shapes: unanchored-regex bypass: any string containing one allowed char

O8_uncovered_routes.route: OIDC auto-provisioning stores preferred_username raw. A username of exactly `..` passes the fix's filepath.Base equality check, so export joins exportDir/../<book> and leaves the export dir.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: OIDC is a neighbouring auth feature, the IdP is trusted, and the Base-equality check looks complete.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: handlers/auth.go -> services/auth.go:103-107 -> cli/migrate.go; 3 packages from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI `user add` builds db.CreateUser directly, so huma pattern tags never run. A `..` username reaches the export join the same way.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-only CLI with a trusted operator, and the schema fix seems to cover usernames.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the sink, other file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: import variant that reads book/note slugs from a manifest or v1 front matter instead of dir names, then joins them
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: export-v1 already writes front matter (backend/cli/migrate.go:307-315), so a matching v1 importer is a natural feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: human-readable disk/backup layout keyed by username/book slug instead of note UUID
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer adding browsable on-disk storage would reuse the export layout

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-book HTTP export/zip endpoint that builds archive entry names from slugs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: common feature request; it would copy the CLI export loop

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22) via stored identifiers used as path components; input validation ineffective (CWE-20, unanchored regex)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 (backend/go.mod:3); huma v2.37.3; gorm with pure-Go sqlite (glebarez)
O10_build.project_tests: Only backend/storage/storage_test.go. There are no tests for cli/migrate.go or db/types.go at the pinned commit; the fix adds backend/db/types_test.go.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Anchor the regex patterns in backend/db/types.go only. That leaves OIDC/CLI usernames and pre-existing stored rows reaching the export join, or it patches only `export` and not `export-v1`.

out_of_scope_notes: Asset name `..` passes both backend/handlers/assets.go:90 and the export-v1 Base check (backend/cli/migrate.go:335-340); os.Create on a directory errors and aborts the export (prior advisory's item, not pursued).
validate:"slug" tags on backend/db/models.go:72,90 are never registered with any validator (dead defence).
unverified: repo_mb not measured. tiny_repo is inferred from about 33 Go and 55 TS/TSX source files.
